note: Measured gate-lane wall clock on successful CI. Read by tools/gate-duration.mjs; CI fails when a lane exceeds the committed baseline by more than maxFactor. Re-measure before changing a baseline; do not hand-edit a number just to make CI green.

batch.evidence: 2026-10-12 re-baseline for #1351, which widened gate 7 (clauses) from 12 serial runs to an 80-run mean fanned over the bounded gate workers. Hosted measurements of the exact change: PR check run 38188378911 (d57d4922, 12/12 batch gates) measured 8.4m in tools/gate-duration.mjs; native merge-group run 38190129301 (68d8e76f, 12/12 batch gates, otherwise green) measured 8.8m and was refused only by the 1.25x guard on the old 7.0m baseline. Batch jobs on the same lane immediately before the change took about 7.5m end to end (PR #1292 check run 38165659035; main merge-group run 38189632987), so the growth is attributable to gate 7, about +1.3m on hosted runners against +0.5m measured on a four-core container. Budget rounded to 9.0m (540s); maxFactor 1.25 = 11.25m guard. Previous baseline: 7.0m (420s) from 2026-10-08 runs 37732468827 and 37733144405 after #439. Sources: https://github.com/EldritchDynasty/EldritchDynasty/actions/runs/38188378911 ; https://github.com/EldritchDynasty/EldritchDynasty/actions/runs/38190129301. Refs #1351, #334.

blood.evidence: #644 complete-sample measurement on GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest / Node 22: successful job 113752914137 in run 37910095094 at 5823a46a played all 2,048 concentrate/dilute pairs x 500y with four workers and one aggregate verdict. Structured artifact widened-blood-measurement records blood.seconds=2275.964 (37m55.964s), ok=true; paired fontLate +0.32, PASS at 2.1 standard errors against the unchanged zero floor / two-SE requirement. Retains every original 1,024 pair and extends the same seed stride, following red main weekly run 37906699185 (+0.43, sd 7.06, 1.9 SE; prescribed ~1,304 pairs). Baseline rounded to 38m, keeping maxFactor 1.25 = 47.5m guard. The isolated measurement job passed; the surrounding exploratory workflow failed its CI inventory checks because of the temporary measurement-only job, which is removed from the final change. This is measured timing, not reusable trusted-main proof. Previous 1,024-pair baseline: PR #490 run 37256335551, 20m59.6s versus pre-worker 39m06.5s (#440). Sources: https://github.com/EldritchDynasty/EldritchDynasty/actions/runs/37910095094/job/113752914137 ; https://github.com/EldritchDynasty/EldritchDynasty/actions/runs/37906699185.
